scope: Corollary 6.3 (Overlap and output tail) of the manuscript “Regular trajectories, pruning and quantum parity” (preprints/Regular-trajectories-pruning-and-quantum-parity-September-24-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 274 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 de3f7a04ba137876), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 20. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Under the hypotheses of Corollary 6.2, write ψt = Wψ0. For any product test B at the output and every fixed 0 < p < h < 1, ∥PBψt∥2 ∥1HB≥mh ψt∥ ≤ exp(−mp ) eventually. (6.2) For each fixed (h, p), both this estimate and (6.1) hold eventually uniformly over the output test B.
